selected_mask_horner.explicit_G_expression: h + (1 + L16^26)*explicit_g; source computes exponent 26 using x²,x⁴,x⁸,x¹⁶ and x¹⁶*x⁸*x².

selected_copy_terminal.source: crates/aspis-statement/src/pool_v1/pair_forest_copy_terminal.rs and copy constants, plus the included R57/R113 gather files.
selected_copy_terminal.selector_construction: expand begins with weights[0]=1; for each coordinate it replaces parent by parent*(1-coordinate) and parent*coordinate. at_point uses point[..6] to create 64 high weights and point[6..] to create 16 low weights. row(r)=high[r>>4]*low[r&15].
selected_copy_terminal.selected_feature_path: R373 frozen selected feature list includes copy-tag-dot-basis-audit and copy-finish-dot-basis-audit; the saved Cargo feature-implication map selects copy-selector-tensor-basis-audit for those. The tensor path accumulates generated registry terms and combines high-side gathered forms with low selectors. Exact code lines are excerpted.
selected_copy_terminal.endpoint_data: patterns are lambda-weighted sums of the 16 opening values plus lifted constant offsets. For every COPY_LINKS entry, each producer and consumer endpoint contributes a row selector times a tag-plus-pattern value to a two-slot values array, and a row selector times its edge weight to a two-slot weights array. Selected 136-link/14-pattern arrays are frozen generated constants.
selected_copy_terminal.copy_residual: Set d0=chi-producer_values[0], d1=chi-producer_values[1], d2=chi-consumer_values[0], d3=chi-consumer_values[1]; P=d0*d1 and C=d2*d3; Pn=producer_weights[0]*d1+producer_weights[1]*d0; Cn=consumer_weights[0]*d3+consumer_weights[1]*d2. Then R=P*(h1*C+Cn)-C*Pn.
selected_copy_terminal.copy_terminal_output: active is computed from the selector table; return residual=active*R and active. The semantic composition starts with this residual, folds 24 semantic packed lanes and then four Poseidon packed lanes; scalar skeleton therefore contains theta^28*active*R.

terminal_context.source: pair_forest_semantic_terminal.rs:1216-1310,1396-1431; payment_terminal exact wrapper is indexed by R373 inventory.
terminal_context.expression: composition starts at copy.residual and reverse-folds semantic then Poseidon lanes. original=eq(zerocheck_point,point)*composition + mu*h1 + mu^2*(1-active)*h1. The selected masked terminal returns mask_value + eta*original. Under selected cfg, payment_terminal subsequently subtracts claims[27]*explicit_g_mask_factor and adds claims[27], then adds positive-transfer delta.
